Flow A is the less usual side: lessons that start at the office of Sam's second company, Lee Driver Ed, plus its classroom course.

Prices are the example schools' own, not a standard. Lee Driving School: 2-hour lesson with pick-up $179, teen package (three 2-hour lessons) $450, road-test car $165, freeway lesson $199 ($249 with Sam), extra time $120 an hour ($140 with Diego), missed-lesson fee $89.
